limits.what: A session that runs on Boat. The verify stack has no Boat; the box (VM 131) does.
Upgrading or migrating an install that already holds people's data. A local stack starts with an empty database.
The preview deploy itself: the script only ever runs on the box.

An agent really running a turn. A local stack has no real agent login: its recipes sign agents in with published fake values the provider refuses, so no Claude or Codex turn runs there. A route of the new web app (apps/web) sent here runs on the box from its checkout: pnpm verify drive new-web --box serves it in front of the box's API, so a change that is only apps/web and packages/ui needs no preview deploy (the verify skill, section 9).
